meta.title: Multi-tenant SaaS platform
meta.subtitle: What your software would look like as a SaaS that bills every month: customers with isolated data, billing in Colombian pesos, an invoice for every charge, users and roles, a portal with each customer's brand and a panel to run operations and support.
meta.caseLine: Sample case: {product}, a fictitious software for managing residential complexes, sold by subscription. Each complex is a customer (tenant). Data as of {date}.
meta.sampleHint: Companies, people, tax IDs, emails, IPs and figures are fictitious.
meta.simBadge: Simulation: no charges, emails or server
meta.resetConfirm: Erase your changes and go back to the sample data?

dunning.title: Failed payments
dunning.subtitle: If a charge fails: notices on days 0, 3 and 7 and suspension on day 10. Paying at any time brings the customer up to date.

msgs.0:
Hello, {tenant} team:
We couldn't charge the {vendor} subscription for {amount}. You can pay by card, PSE or Nequi from your portal to avoid interruptions.
msgs.1:
Hello, {tenant} team:
Your {vendor} subscription is still pending ({amount}). If you already paid, ignore this message.
msgs.2:
Hello, {tenant} team:
Final notice: if we don't receive the payment of {amount}, the service will be suspended on {date}.

wa.0: {vendor}: we couldn't charge the {tenant} subscription ({amount}). Pay from your portal.
wa.1: {vendor}: reminder, the {tenant} subscription is still pending ({amount}).
wa.2: {vendor}: final notice. If we don't receive the payment of {amount}, the {tenant} service will be suspended.
